briefdescription.para: createPrinterPass - Get a function printer pass.
run - Execute all of the passes scheduled for execution.

detaileddescription.para: Keep track of whether any of the passes modifies the module, and if so, return true.

briefdescription.para: doInitialization - Run all of the initializers for the function passes.
doFinalization - Run all of the finalizers for the function passes.
Pass Manager itself does not invalidate any analysis info.
